fact.en: Mistaking Harsha as a follower of Buddhism from birth; he was a Shiva worshipper who later patronized Mahayana Buddhism.

fact.en: Assuming the caste system was rigid; Xuanzang reports flexibility in occupations for certain groups (e.g., Shudras as agriculturists).

fact.en: Overestimating the extent of decentralized administration; feudalism was present but the state remained highly organized.
